title: Cron execution environment
summary: Compare user and system crontabs, scheduler context, PATH, output handling and timing assumptions.

concepts.title: Crontab type
concepts.explanation: User crontabs and system crontabs differ, including whether a user field is present.

concepts.title: Minimal context
concepts.explanation: Scheduled jobs commonly inherit a smaller environment than interactive shells.

concepts.title: Evidence capture
concepts.explanation: Scheduler logs and controlled job output help distinguish “not launched” from “launched and failed”.

limitations: Service names and logging locations vary by platform and cron implementation.
Full environment dumps may disclose secrets and should not be the default diagnostic method.
